arxiv-2405-14481.title: A logic of judgmental existence and its relation to proof irrelevance
arxiv-2405-14481.creator: Ivo Pezlar
arxiv-2405-14481.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ivo Pezlar. We introduce a simple natural deduction system for reasoning with judgments of the form “there exists a proof of
\varphi
” to explore the notion of judgmental existence following Martin-Löf’s methodology of distinguishing between judgments and propositions. In this system, the existential judgment can be internalized into a modal notion of propositional existence that is closely related to truncation modality, a key tool for obtaining proof irrelevance, and lax modality.
